Employee Handbook
Leave Policy
Employees receive 20 paid leave days annually, 12 sick leave days, and 10 public holidays.
Planned leave requires manager approval at least 5 business days in advance.
Working Hours
Standard working hours are Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM IST. Flexible hours are allowed
between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM start time.
Remote Work
Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval.
